1.explanation:
1. Toolbar/Toolbar.js – this is the container that wires in the search-box component (role=searchbox).  
2. ToolbarSearch/ToolbarSearch.js – the component that actually renders the <input role="searchbox">; this is where aria-label or labelText support would need to be added.  
3. ToolbarSearch/ToolbarSearch.story.js – shows how the search control is used in practice, and confirms that no label prop is exposed.  
4. DataTable/README.md – documents how the table toolbar and its search box are consumed in the DataTable API.  
5. DataTable/stories/DataTableTable.story.js – a live example of the DataTable with toolbar search, reproducing the exact scenario in the screenshots.  
6. DataTable/tools/TableToolbarSearch.js – if you have a helper or wrapper for TableToolbarSearch inside DataTable, this file will show how it composes/invokes ToolbarSearch and where the missing label prop should be passed through.
1.bug_scenario: In both screenshots you can see that the search-box in the table toolbar is rendered as an unlabeled edit field (JAWS announces “Unlabeled# Edit”) because the <input> with role="searchbox" has no accessible label or aria-label attribute. The form-field is visible and styled, but screen readers have no text or programmatic label to announce, so they fall back to “Unlabeled” or “? Edit.”
